name: 123 Internet
summary: Budget Melbourne dialup + ADSL ISP (unlimited $15/mo dialup, Melbourne Metro); traded from ~2003 through 2009, gone by ~2010 (domain later reused by unrelated registrar Crazy Domains from ~2014).

events.details: Budget dialup/ADSL, Melbourne Metro ('unlimited high speed dial-up for only $15 per month'). Earliest capture 7 Jun 2003, footer © 2003 (2002 plausible but undocumented).
Retail ISP still live through 2009; homepage replaced by a default cPanel placeholder page dated 14 Oct 2010 (captured 2011–2013). Domain later reused from ~2014 by unrelated registrar Crazy Domains.
